criteria.requirement: Add tasklists_plugin(gfm_whitespace=False) as a strict boolean compatibility option. Default False must preserve the complete existing ordinary-space/tab/formfeed rendering bytes. When True, make_checkbox recognizes the same existing GFM whitespace set as starts_with_todo_markdown, including tab/vertical-tab/formfeed and repeated separators, and derives checked state from the matched space/x/X marker. Every recognized task gets exactly one actual input with matching state and original marker removal; preserve enabled/disabled and label modes. Do not broaden recognition to no-separator [x]text or non-GFM Unicode spaces, and do not merely add task CSS classes without a checkbox.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
